objectives.summary: The project aims to develop CastAI, an AI-powered casting assistant designed to help actors find and apply for roles more efficiently. Key objectives include launching a minimum viable product (MVP) within the first three months, followed by a beta release and a full launch, each introducing new features and enhancements based on user feedback.
key_points: CastAI aims to help actors book more auditions quickly by finding the right roles across major casting platforms.
The MVP features include role discovery and matching, automatic submissions, and a personalized dashboard.
Phase 1 of the roadmap focuses on early access for backers and essential features, while Phase 2 introduces daily updates and priority notifications for high-value roles.
Phase 3 will expand platform coverage and provide advanced career insights, along with mobile access and notifications.
Engaging early users for feedback is part of the strategy to improve accuracy and user experience.
The project includes feedback-driven improvements to enhance the product based on user input.
